review_method: Direct inspection of unmodified PNGs rendered by UE 5.7; no screenshot editing or compositing.
observations: Source leaf cards, branching trunks and leaf-shaped ground shadows are visible in the migrated trees.
The rim debug render follows visible broadleaf canopy edges and leaves the colored water, terrain, trunks and pines visible.
Overview and top-down views retain the lake/coast layout and existing pine placements. The new trees fit within the previous broadleaf dimension bounds.
The approved source palette is more saturated lime green than the earlier muted broadleaf palette. Source tree defaults are intentionally preserved.

The matching lake viewpoint has a nearby foreground trunk at the left edge before and after. Its broader curved shape now occludes more of the upper-left corner. The camera was preserved for comparison.
limitations: A static image pair is supporting evidence for temporal changes, not an interactive performance benchmark.
The source model is wider relative to its height than some old variants, so uniform bounds fitting makes some new trees shorter.
No manual player-controller input or packaged executable was tested; actual PIE possession, movement sweeps and traces were scripted.
